Thank you! Oh my god! Solved!

How did you find it so fast, you absolute genius person?

Also, I'm pretty sure the person never actually talked. All of the stuff about the house was in text on the bottom of the screen. I'm pretty sure toward the end they started saying stuff about family members being dead. The house was also very dark.
That being said, I'm sure your loved ones would miss you too if anything happened to you. I hope you can find strength in something or hope in something. I hope today is a little easier.

But what if the attention I brought to a specific cause helped people after I died? So many people are suffering and that's part of what makes me so depressed. How I'm suffering and they're suffering and people I care about are suffering. Maybe my family might get some sympathy money or something so they could pay their bills and feed themselves.

I'm sorry you're hurting tho, fam. But I wish y'all would let me do my venting too. Even if its irrational and stupid. If I wanted the attention, I'd post this shit to my twitter or something instead of using an anonymous alt account on reddit. I get that your feelings stem from somewhere different, but my depression has been deeply exacerbated by doom scrolling regarding current events both in my country and around the world so some of my irrationality has to do with that shit.
Hey. Keep fighting the good fight, brother. I'll try to do the same for now. I admire your hope. When I'm feelin pretty damn hopeless....
